description: One entry per command: arity and flags as COMMAND INFO reports them, and where the keys are among the arguments (argument 0 is the command name). Generated from the server's command table by `RUVIO_WRITE_CLIENT_SPEC=1 cargo test --lib client_spec`; do not edit by hand.

key_rules.range: arguments first..=last every step; a negative last counts from the end, -1 being the last argument
key_rules.numkeys: the argument at count_at is a key count and that many keys follow it; before, when not 0, is the position of one more key ahead of the count
key_rules.keyword_half: after the argument equal to keyword (any case), the first half of the remaining arguments
key_rules.key_and_store: the argument at first, and the argument after any of keywords (any case)
